name: A, P and the Ribbon
about: The unified Alliance AI Partners palette (chosen 2026-11-01 by a four-proposal, three-judge review; the Figma library's Brand Colors variables hold the same 14 colours). Six core colours keep the brand board's exact values; eight shading tokens on two lightness ramps replace the 3D mark's 32 measured tones. build.py draws every master's 3D mark from it through stopMap (measured stop -> token), and the Brand Graphics too: stopMap.graphics gives each of the 72 tones measured in the swallow, shield, wave, data mesh and pattern tiles its nearest palette colour (CIEDE2000), so they use these 14 colours and no others. The Original Recreations keep their measured inks.

core.name: Alliance Blue
core.role: The AI in light lockups, the Flat-Light mark, the Mono-White ground, and the lit faces of the 3D A
core.story: The A, for Alliance: the mark's lit faces are the same blue as the AI, so mark and wordmark share one blue.

core.name: Ribbon Cyan
core.role: The ribbon's light in both 3D colourways; the AI and one-colour mark on dark grounds; the descriptor rule
core.story: The ribbon that binds A and P: one cyan everywhere, the light the mark gives off.

core.name: Partner Navy
core.role: All type on light grounds, the dark ground, and the deepest shadow of the light mark
core.story: The P, for Partner: the ink of every word and the floor of every shadow in the mark.

core.name: Pure White
core.role: Paper and knockout: type and the Mono-White mark on navy or blue grounds
core.story: The knockout: what the mark is cut from.

core.name: Daylight
core.role: Page and panel ground; the paper in print; not a logo ink
core.story: The page Daybreak rises into: a light ground with a trace of the navy's hue.

core.name: Black
core.story: One ink, for when only one ink is possible.

shading.name: Partner 30
shading.role: the P's underside and the shadow band of the A's left bevel (light mark)

shading.name: Partner 38
shading.role: slate shadow faces of the A's right leg; deepest faces of the dark mark

shading.name: Partner 46
shading.role: slate mid faces (P bowl, A's right leg); also secondary text on white

shading.name: Partner 50
shading.role: lifted slate highlights of the dark mark on navy

shading.name: Alliance 38
shading.role: deep-blue shadow bands on the A under the ribbon (light mark)

shading.name: Alliance 46
shading.role: blue faces turning into shadow, the ribbon's shaded end; hover/pressed Alliance Blue

shading.name: Alliance 50
shading.role: the top of the A's left bevel in both colourways

shading.name: Ribbon 57
shading.role: the ribbon's turn from blue into cyan, in both colourways; lies on Daybreak
